errors.text_span: най-голям е тъмносиният сектор за „Other services“ (Други услуги) с 61% (19.0 млн.)
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the largest sector in the 'Number of enterprises' chart is 'Other services' (dark blue) with 61%, but the image shows 'Industry' (yellow) as the largest sector with 61%.
The description incorrectly assigns 12% (3.7 mln) to 'Construction' (light blue) in the 'Number of enterprises' chart, but the image shows 'Other services' (brown) with these values.
The description incorrectly assigns 8% (2.4 mln) to 'Industry' (golden brown) in the 'Number of enterprises' chart, but the image shows 'Construction' (light blue) with these values.
The description incorrectly states that the 'Number of persons employed' chart has 'Other services' (dark blue) at 51%, but the image shows 'Industry' (yellow) with these values.
The description incorrectly assigns 21% (33.0 mln) to 'Industry' (golden brown) in the 'Number of persons employed' chart, but the image shows 'Other services' (brown) with these values.
The description incorrectly states that the 'Turnover' chart has 'Other services' (dark blue) at 31%, but the image shows 'Industry' (yellow) with these values.
The description incorrectly assigns 33% (10.6 trln) to 'Industry' (golden brown) in the 'Turnover' chart, but the image shows 'Other services' (brown) with these values.
The description does not explicitly state that the charts represent the distribution of enterprises, employment, and turnover by industry, construction, trade, and other services in 2021.
The description does not mention that the sectors are visually distinguished by color coding as per the legend.
The description does not mention that the charts include both percentage and absolute values within each sector.
